columns.name: Patagonia
columns.thesis: Doubling down on circularity as a product moat, not just a values line.

events.headline: $18M into Tin Shed Ventures Fund IV
events.detail: Portfolio skewing to bio-based dyes and mycelium leather startups.
events.implies: Worn Wear scaling to in-country repair — service as product.

events.headline: Filed: solvent-free DWR coating process
events.detail: USPTO application 2026/0421 — replaces C6 chemistry entirely.
events.implies: PFAS-free rain shells become a real spec claim, not marketing.

events.headline: 3 senior roles in Repair Network Ops
events.detail: New hub roles in Reno, Amsterdam, Osaka.
events.implies: Worn Wear moving from campaign to P&L line.

columns.name: Arc'teryx
columns.thesis: Buying its way into the community layer it never earned organically.

events.headline: Acquired trail-run app Kōan (undisclosed)
events.detail: Small Vancouver team, ~40k MAU, GPS + route sharing.
events.implies: First-party athlete data feed — expect a connected shoe within a year.

events.headline: Whistler advanced materials lab expansion
events.detail: Doubling headcount on 3D-knit and seamless construction.

events.headline: 12 firmware engineers — Vancouver HQ
events.detail: Embedded systems, BLE, sensor fusion. None existed a quarter ago.
events.implies: Hardware is no longer a rumour.

columns.name: The North Face
columns.thesis: Betting on urban-adjacent culture and heat, not the mountain.

events.headline: Minority stake in Kelvin Thermal Technologies
events.implies: Summer product line pivoting to cooling — climate-hedge assortment.

events.headline: Filed: modular puffer with swappable insulation cassette
events.detail: One shell, seasonal fills — reduces returns and inventory risk.
events.implies: Aiming to own the 'one jacket, four seasons' story before Uniqlo.

events.headline: VP of Cultural Marketing, based Seoul
events.detail: Former Nike SB and Adidas Originals background.
events.implies: APAC streetwear push, less alpine — brand drifts urban.
